pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal dark regions with moderately smooth pixel gradients at the edges. The patches exhibit large spatial area on the mid-flank and transition to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological network. Pixel thickness is variable, widening at junction nodes which are primarily trivalent across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck, formed by the short, stiff hairs of the mane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical structural indentation or skin crease is visible immediately posterior to the shoulder region.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark avian specimen (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge toward the posterior portion of the visible torso.
